name: Get App CTA Clicked
description: Fires when a Hent appen control or a campaign banner in the nav is clicked. The badge click itself is Store Badge Clicked.

name: Store Badge Clicked
description: Fires server-side when an App Store or Google Play badge is clicked (store, position).

name: Newsletter Signup
description: Fires server-side when the newsletter form is accepted (scope). The address is never sent.

name: Waitlist Signup Confirmed
description: Fires server-side when the API confirms a successful waitlist signup.
